listing.name: Strikecraft Standalone v1.0.0
listing.summary: Do you want to use mods that include strikecraft, but don't want to have the full suite of armaa's features, such as its faction and mechs, in your game?
listing.aiSummary: Adds only the Strikecraft hullmod to allow other mods to function without requiring the full Armaa suite.

description: Provides a standalone version of the Strikecraft hullmod for users who want compatibility with mods that depend on it but do not wish to install the entire Armaa faction and mech content. It uses the original ID of the hullmod, allowing it to act as a direct substitute for Armaa in most cases.

conflicts.name: Arma Armatura
conflicts.quote: Do NOT run this mod alongside armaa, use one or the other. Besides there being no reason to do so as armaa contains everything in this mod to start with, the two will also crash the game if used alongside eachother.
